meta.title: MATLAB/Simulink Control Assistant
meta.description: Bridges the MathWorks MATLAB MCP Server with the Simulink Agentic Toolkit registry, adding 14 mcp__matlab__* tools and four skills (simulink-model-check, simulink-simulation-run, app-designer-ui, control-design) for model structure checks, simulation summaries, App Designer code, and PID/frequency/state-space analysis with structured metrics. Trigger it in natural language, e.g. "check this model" or "tune a PID for tf(1,[1 1])". Requires MATLAB R2023a+ with Simulink and the MATLAB MCP Server binary; the first tool call after startup takes 1-3 minutes while MATLAB boots, and the toolkit needs addpath per MATLAB session (the skills do this).
